baseline.open_pr_verification_method: GitHub open-PR search followed by individual live state readback for all 56 returned PRs

acceptance.criterion: Candidate is based on current remote main
acceptance.merge_rule: Recheck immediately before merge; any main advance requires reconciliation and fresh checks.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly one Phase-2 PR-census integration lane

acceptance.evidence: Three .github/governance paths only; public-impact classifier and complete diff must confirm zero protected rendered/runtime paths.

acceptance.criterion: Presidencia publication remains outside the transaction
acceptance.evidence: Explicit user boundary and candidate path allowlist.
56 open PRs individually read back as open and assigned exactly one primary handling disposition.
acceptance.open_work: Proposition/file-level unique-delta review remains open for all 56; no backlog PR is merged or closed here.

acceptance.criterion: Publicly served operational snapshots are not altered by a governance-only transaction
acceptance.evidence: The repository uses .nojekyll and live workflows read /ops routes from the public host; all ops paths were removed from this candidate after the conservative public-impact gate returned YES_OR_UNKNOWN.
acceptance.boundary: CURRENT_STATE, CURRENT_COLLABORATION_STATE, PR_RECONCILIATION_LEDGER, PRODUCTION_STATUS and RELEASE_LEDGER remain stale checked-in observations. Refresh requires a separately authorized public-surface transaction.

acceptance.criterion: All applicable exact-head gates are green
acceptance.merge_rule: Do not merge if any applicable required or changed-surface check is pending, cancelled, skipped unexpectedly or failing.

acceptance.criterion: Control Tower contains candidate and closeout receipts
acceptance.merge_rule: Register the candidate before merge and record exact tested head, merge SHA and gate outcome after merge.

reason: The proposed transaction removes primary-routing ambiguity from the full 56-PR baseline denominator while preserving the no-public-change boundary. Exact-head CI, current-main recheck, merge and controller verification remain required before the decision becomes effective on main; public operational-snapshot refresh remains open.
claim_boundary: This record measures repository coordination only. It is not a claim that the evidence corpus, legal programme, GitLab recovery, backup programme or Presidencia work is complete.
